patients.label: 62-year-old female Egyptian patient with mandibular small cell osteosarcoma, right mandibular molar area

identity_evidence.quote: A 62-year-old female Egyptian patient attended to the outpatient clinic of the Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery Department, Cairo University in October 2022, complaining of a large painful swelling related to the right mandibular molar area (Fig. 1).

attribution_limitations: Abstract case presentation summarizes the same individual; figure captions are descriptive of the same individual but do not add independent clinical course details.

evidence.quote: Preoperative clinical picture showing a large swelling causing buccal and lingual cortical plate expansion with nonhealing mucosa due to previous incisions
A CBCT image showing large radiolucent lesion related to the lower right molar area with inferior alveolar nerve involvement. B Negative image showing trabecular bone infiltration by tumor cells
Histopathological findings of the tumor. Sheets of small round cells with minimal osteoid deposition [hematoxylin–eosin (H–E) stain, × 200]
Histopathological findings of the tumor. Tumor small round cells having hyperchromatic, round nuclei, and scant cytoplasm [hematoxylin–eosin (H–E) stain, × 200]
Histopathological findings of the tumor. Small round cells and evident osteoid formation [hematoxylin–eosin (H–E) stain × 200]
Immunohistochemical staining of tumor cells showing diffuse positive nuclear staining for SATB2 marker × 200

limitations: Literature review table rows b00015-b00021 describe previously reported cases and are background, not original patients in this article.
Discussion paragraphs b00014, b00021, b00022, b00027 refer to the index case in aggregate terms and to literature; attribution is limited to the index case where explicitly linked.

review_method: Agent checked original case count, identity and species against source; roster scaffold from prior pilot; not physician adjudication.
